subject: Request: trial rollover and scale options for Meridian POC
messages:
From: Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@meridian.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@meridian.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial rollover request + capacity spike next month

Hi Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Meridian is seeing promising results on a few internal benchmarks and we want to stretch the trial to cover a short spike next month where we plan to route ~3x our current traffic for a 10-day window.

Our questions:
- Can we extend the current 30-day evaluation by 14 days, to cover the spike window (we'd run the extra days in July)?
- Is there a simple way to provision temporary burst capacity for that 10-day period without committing to a higher reserved tier?
- Any guidance you can share on how that surge would affect token pricing / overage vs short-term commit?

We know this is a bit ad hoc — happy to take a call. If there's a lightweight addendum/one-pager you can send, that would help fast-track internal sign-off.

Cheers,
Simon Lewis
Director of Applied AI
Meridian Analytics
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@meridian.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial rollover request + capacity spike next month

Simon —

Really glad the demo landed well. Quick answers up front, then a proposed path: 

- Extension: Yes, we can extend the evaluation by 14 days with a short amend; we typically do this as a timebox extension (no additional prepay required) but we include a short usage cap so both sides avoid surprises.
- Burst capacity: We can provision burstable capacity for short windows via our Dedicated temporary pool (no long-term commit). That would be billed at a short-term uplift rate for the burst days only.
- Pricing impact: For short bursts we offer a burst uplift (typically +35% on per-token hosted rates) or an option to pre-purchase a small short-term bucket at a discounted uplift vs pure overage.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a one-page addendum with two concrete options — (A) timebox extension + burst uplift billed per-use, (B) timebox extension + one-off short-term token bucket (prepaid) at a lower effective uplift.
2) If you pick (B) we’ll attach a simple amendment and provision the bucket; if (A) we can just accept terms by reply and enable burst.
3) Marissa / Ben — can you draft the one-pager and a pricing table by EOD Tuesday so we can share with Meridian?

Happy to sync on a quick call tomorrow if useful.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

Thanks Hannah — that approach sounds reasonable. A couple of clarifying notes from our procurement side before we finalize: 

- For option (B) (prepaid bucket), can you quantify the minimum bucket size you’d recommend for a 10-day 3x spike given our May usage (I’ve attached a quick CSV snapshot)?
- Will the prepaid bucket carry over if we don’t fully use it in that 14-day extension? (we’d prefer some tolerance for unused tokens)
- Any visibility into SLA impact for burst capacity (latency targets) — we need to make sure the spike won’t cause degraded performance for other concurrent workloads.

Appreciate fast turnaround. If you can send the two-option one-pager + recommended bucket sizes we’ll present to our CTO today.

Best,
Priya Desai
Procurement Manager — Meridian Analytics
Attachment: Meridian-Usage-Snapshot-May2026.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@meridian.ai>, Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@meridian.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial rollover request + capacity spike next month

Hi Priya / Simon —

Thanks for the usage snapshot — that’s helpful. Attached is a short addendum and two concrete pricing paths (PDF):

Option A — Timebox extension + burst-as-you-go
- 14-day extension to the existing evaluation (no prepay)
- Burstable capacity enabled for a 10-day window within the extension
- Burst uplift: +35% on standard hosted per-token rates during the 10 days
- Soft usage cap: we’ll cap total cost exposure to 4x your current 10-day baseline unless you authorize higher usage
- No carryover of unused burst usage under this path

Option B — Timebox extension + prepaid short-term bucket (recommended)
- 14-day extension + prepaid token bucket sized for an estimated 3x spike over 10 days
- Recommended bucket: 6 million tokens (based on your May snapshot)
- Effective uplift: +18% vs standard rate (cheaper than pure burst uplifts)
- Carryover: unused tokens roll into your standard trial balance for 30 days post-extension (up to 25% of bucket)
- SLA: burst capacity provisions are on Dedicated temporary pool; latency targets remain aligned with your existing evaluation SLAs (p99 latency within 1.3x baseline).

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Options-2026-05.pdf (PDF, 85KB) — includes table with exact unit prices and amendment language; Meridian-Usage-Snapshot-May2026.csv (CSV, 12KB) — as provided.

If you’re comfortable with Option B we can issue a short amendment and provision the bucket within 24 hours of sign-off. Otherwise we’ll enable burst and track usage under Option A.

Next step: Simon / Priya — please reply with preferred option and we’ll route the amendment. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
